implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 456 HDL source files (23 systemverilog, 279 verilog, 154 vhdl) alongside 1 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 2 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 1 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 1 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 1 distinct machine_id rows. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-TrioThePunch_MiSTer/blob/master/TrioThePunch.sv carries the tag SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later, and https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-TrioThePunch_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 3 text, which agrees -- read from the repository, not inferred. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 456 source files (23 systemverilog, 279 verilog, 154 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
